### Files created:

1. **`zcl_po_item_reader.clas.abap`** — New class with the actual business logic
   - Typed result structure with only the needed fields (not full `EKPO`)
   - New ABAP SQL syntax (`@` host variables, comma-separated fields, `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`)
   - `RETURNING VALUE(result)` functional style
   - Mandatory parameter (no `OPTIONAL`)

2. **`zfm_write_po_item_refactored.fugr.abap`** — Thin FM wrapper that delegates to the class
   - FM now exports structured data instead of using `WRITE`
   - Separation of concerns: data retrieval vs. presentation
   - Follows Clean ABAP guideline: *"procedural objects should do little more than call a corresponding class"*

### Key changes:
- ✅ Object-oriented design (class + thin FM wrapper)
- ✅ New ABAP SQL syntax with `@` escaping and inline declarations
- ✅ `RETURNING VALUE(result)` instead of `EXPORTING`
- ✅ Typed structure with only needed fields (no full `EKPO`)
- ✅ Inline declarations (`DATA(...)`, `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(...)`)
- ✅ No chained `DATA:` statements
- ✅ Mandatory parameter with guard clause
- ✅ No `WRITE` in the function module — caller handles display
